description: This file contains the implementation of the CosmosMembershipTable class, which manages membership data for silos in a distributed Orleans cluster using Azure Cosmos DB as storage. It includes methods for initializing, reading, updating, and deleting membership entries, as well as handling Cosmos DB resource management.

classes.name: CosmosMembershipTable
classes.description: A class that implements IMembershipTable to store and retrieve membership data in Azure Cosmos DB for Orleans silos.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, sets up Cosmos DB resources, and reads or creates the cluster version.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a given cluster ID.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silos marked as dead before a certain date.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a single silo membership entry by its address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all membership entries and the cluster version.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new silo membership entry with a specified table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing silo membership entry given an ETag and table version.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a silo.
